correctness.rationale: The property depends only on residues modulo 16, with admissible residues exactly those not divisible by four and a witness exactly a four-submultiset whose sum is \(4,8\), or \(12\) modulo 16. Fresh exhaustive enumeration of all \(167960\) nondecreasing length-nine multisets found a witness in every case, while among all \(75582\) length-eight multisets exactly 160 were witness-free. An explicit bad eight gives the lower bound. Applying every odd multiplier and translation by a multiple of four partitions precisely those 160 extremals into orbit sizes \(32,32,16,8,32,32,8\), with the stated seven representatives.

originality.rationale: Sun's source formulates the general constant and conjectures \(s_1(n)=2n+1\); its stated bounds leave the first composite case within a one-unit gap. The earlier Gao et al. problem is prime-modulus, and the later local theorem has a different subset-size quantifier. Resultary returned the assigned finding as the exact \(n=4\) resolution and no prior exact classification. The theorem therefore appears to close a genuine stated boundary case rather than recompute a known table.
